evaluation.source: Held-out route evaluation; Golden Path runs are excluded.

live_tally.honesty_note: Session counter, not the model's overall accuracy.

detection_report.model: LCCDE ensemble (LightGBM + XGBoost + CatBoost), leaders chosen on a validation split
detection_report.dataset: CICIDS2017 (5% sample from the Western OC2 Lab repository)
detection_report.split: Stratified random 80/20 split after removing duplicate rows (not ordered by time), seed 0
detection_report.notes: This is an offline public sample, not live traffic, and is not comparable with NIDS's live Isolation Forest detector.

honesty_notes: Evaluation uses held-out routes only; Golden Path rehearsals are excluded.
Precision@3 is 1.0 for all methods because at most three hosts are reachable.
The Markov model's precision@1 is only slightly above the rule-based baseline.
The detection report is an offline public sample and is not comparable with the live detector.
The live value is a session counter, not the model's overall accuracy.
